title: Self-focusing in a glass plate (spatial model)
summary: A 4 µJ, 300 fs pulse at 1030 nm (about 3 times the critical power) crosses 10 mm of fused silica with a 100 µm collimated beam; the Kerr lens shrinks the beam to 97.4 µm against 102.5 µm without it, the wavefront curves to R = -70 mm and the pulse on axis is 234 fs against 327 fs in the wings.
